issue.body: For most of my projects I've been using `eslint ./` which has been working for me for some time. This worked with v1.3.1 but not v1.4.1. In v1.4.1 it seems as though this is starting from the root directory and trying to run eslint against all the javascript files on my system. This also appears to be broken with v1.4.0.
